decisions.reason: The formwork profile system draws directly on the firm's core formwork knowledge, so it can keep reading customer results and refining the line in-house, though its absence from the website in 2020-2021 adds some uncertainty.

Automated concrete distributor flow control fits the firm's strategic automation push and its own R&D capability, but it was only briefly mentioned and not observed later, which raises the withdrawal risk somewhat.

Magnetic formwork strips are a core-adjacent product line the firm understands well, and they survived the 2019 pruning of weaker magnetic items, which suggests they are among the stronger performers.
This magnetic formwork component builds closely on existing know-how, but overlap with other magnetic products and its absence from later website observations make consolidation somewhat more likely.
